title: Echoes: The Best of Pink Floyd
headline: What did Pink Floyd almost call their greatest hits? Roger Waters had to step in.
caption:
Echoes: The Best of Pink Floyd came out on 5 November 2001, 25 years ago today. It runs from their first single, "Arnold Layne", to "High Hopes", and every track fades into the next with no break, like one long Floyd album.

The cover has its own backstory. Storm Thorgerson's design of endless windows started life as one of two sketches for Dream Theater's 1997 album Falling into Infinity. The original now hangs framed in the home of Dream Theater drummer Mike Portnoy.

And for all the drama over the name, the album debuted at No. 2 in the US, kept off the top only by Britney Spears' Britney.

Which Pink Floyd song would you put first on a best-of?

🎧 Key track: "Echoes" by Pink Floyd (@pinkfloyd)
